boot_source.scope: Original unmodified43-file artifact preserved permanently in Releases. Native mapped full-interface CORRPRE/SYNPRE0 packet-async boot28checks and independent PCIe idle samples; actual system and both Ethernet MBIST busy/done handover observed. Exact native netlist hash agrees with simulation input record. No packet traffic, noSDF, qualified physical timing, arbitrary faults or PHY acceptance. CORRPRE remains experimental and not adopted in routed mainchip.

interpretation: Native boot/MBIST and CTS completed, not timing closure. Inherited mixed-stage metrics must not be treated as new all-corner timing evidence. Exact postCTS run discards inherited metrics and remeasures.
